photos.credit: RE/MAX Aruba listing, Gold Coast Diamante 75
photos.shows: Diamante 75 street facade: strong yellow walls, white arched door surround, curved wrought-iron balcony, white pediment with a round medallion, orange planters along the paver drive. The door is numbered 75.
